scenes.line1: How do you update APIs safely?
scenes.say: How do you update an API without breaking your users? What does versioning actually do?

scenes.label: Versioning
scenes.sub: Lets APIs evolve without breaking clients.
scenes.say: Versioning lets your API grow and change, but keeps old clients working just fine.
You can version an API using the URI, headers, or even the media type in the Accept header.
Backward compatibility means old clients keep working. If you break it, users hit errors.

scenes.question: How do you handle breaking changes?
scenes.right: Release a new version, keep old one working.
scenes.say: In interviews, never say you just change endpoints. Always mention releasing a new version and keeping the old one running.
